title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Implementation Measures for Establishing a Mechanism for Resolving Discrepancies in the Application of Law
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Implementation Measures for Establishing a Mechanism for Resolving Differences in the Application of Law

Fa Fa [2019] No. 23

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; all special people's courts; and all operational departments of this Court:

The Implementation Measures for Establishing a Mechanism for Resolving Differences in the Application of Law of the Supreme People's Court, adopted at the 1776th session of the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court on September 9, 2019, shall come into force on October 28, 2019. They are hereby issued for your diligent implementation.

October 11, 2019

Implementation Measures for Establishing a Mechanism for Resolving Differences in the Application of Law

Article 1. The Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court (hereinafter referred to as the "Judicial Committee") is the leading and decision-making body for the work of resolving differences in the application of law of the Supreme People's Court. The Trial Management Office of the Supreme People's Court (hereinafter referred to as the "Trial Management Office"), all operational departments of the Supreme People's Court, and the China Institute of Applied Jurisprudence (hereinafter referred to as the "Institute of Applied Jurisprudence") shall, in accordance with the needs of the work of resolving differences in the application of law, provide services and decision-making references for the decisions of the Judicial Committee, and shall be responsible for implementing the decisions of the Judicial Committee.

Article 2. Any operational department of the Supreme People's Court, any High People's Court, or any special people's court that, during the trial or enforcement of a case, discovers any of the following circumstances shall submit an application to the Trial Management Office for resolving a difference in the application of law:

(1) There exists a difference in the application of law between effective judgments of the Supreme People's Court; or

(2) The outcome of a judgment to be rendered in a pending case may differ from the principle or standard for the application of law established by an effective judgment of the Supreme People's Court.

Article 3. If, during the organization of special research on similar cases and consistent judgments of the people's courts, the Institute of Applied Jurisprudence discovers a difference in the application of law between effective judgments of the Supreme People's Court, it shall submit an application to the Trial Management Office for resolving the difference in the application of law.

Article 4. An application for resolving a difference in the application of law shall include the following materials:

(1) A written application for resolving a difference in the application of law. The application shall identify and summarize the legal issues on which the difference in the application of law exists;

(2) The judgment documents or case numbers of the Supreme People's Court judgments in which the difference in the application of law exists;

(3) Any other materials that need to be submitted. If the materials contain information concerning a pending case, information about the parties and any other information that may affect the fair trial of the case shall be redacted.

Article 5. Upon receipt of an application for resolving a difference in the application of law, the Trial Management Office shall promptly conduct a review. If the conditions for case registration are met, it shall register the case and forward the relevant materials to the Institute of Applied Jurisprudence.

Article 6. Within five working days after receiving the materials forwarded by the Trial Management Office, the Institute of Applied Jurisprudence shall conduct research on the issue of the difference in the application of law raised in the application, form a preliminary review opinion, and forward it to the Trial Management Office.

Article 7. After receiving the preliminary review opinion from the Institute of Applied Jurisprudence, the Trial Management Office shall, in accordance with the functional division of labor for trial and enforcement work of the Supreme People's Court, forward the preliminary review opinion to the corresponding operational department for re-review.

Article 8. The corresponding operational department of the Supreme People's Court shall, upon receipt of the above materials, promptly organize research, form a re-review opinion, and forward it to the Trial Management Office. When necessary, experts may be organized to conduct deliberation.

Article 9. After receiving the re-review opinion from the operational department, the Trial Management Office shall promptly report to the leadership of the Court to request that the Judicial Committee discuss the issue of the difference in the application of law.

Article 10. After the Judicial Committee discusses the issue of the difference in the application of law and makes a decision, the Trial Management Office shall promptly provide feedback on the decision to the unit that submitted the application for resolving the difference in the application of law. It shall also propose opinions on the form and scope of publication based on the nature of the issue and the decision, and implement such publication after approval.

Article 11. The decisions made by the Judicial Committee on differences in the application of law shall be referred to and followed by all operational departments of the Supreme People's Court, all local people's courts at various levels, and all special people's courts in their trial and enforcement work.

Article 12. These Measures shall come into force on October 28, 2019.
